ready2_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: It is known that the solution set of the inequality $a x^{2}-x+b \geq 0$ in $x$ is $[-2,1]$; find the solution set of the inequality $b x^{2}-x+a \leq 0$ in $x$.
ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: It is known that the solution set of the inequality $a x^{2}-x+b \geq 0$ in $x$ is $[-2,1]$; find the solution set of the inequality $b x^{2}-x+a \leq 0$ in $x$.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Read from the problem statement: the solution set of the inequality ax²-x+b≥0 in x is [-2,1]. Therefore the two zeros of the quadratic polynomial ax²-x+b are -2 and 1, and because the solution set of ≥0 is between the two roots, the parabola opens downward. Let ax²-x+b=a(x+2)(x-1). Expanding gives a(x²+x-2)=ax²+ax-2a. Comparing coefficients with ax²-x+b: the coefficient of the x term satisfies a=-1; the constant term satisfies b=-2a=2. Thus the inequality to be solved bx²-x+a≤0 becomes 2x²-x-1≤0. Factoring gives 2x²-x-1=(2x+1)(x-1), so (2x+1)(x-1)≤0. The two roots are x=-1/2 and x=1, and it opens upward, therefore the solution set less than or equal to 0 is between the two roots, namely [-1/2,1].

raw_record.question_text: It is known that the solution set of the inequality $a x^{2}-x+b \geq 0$ in $x$ is $[-2,1]$; find the solution set of the inequality $b x^{2}-x+a \leq 0$ in $x$.

method.method_draft: 先从题面读出：不等式 ax^2-x+b≥0 的解集是 [-2,1]，因此二次多项式 ax^2-x+b 的两个零点是 -2 和 1，且开口向下。设 ax^2-x+b=a(x+2)(x-1)。展开得 a(x^2+x-2)=ax^2+ax-2a。与 ax^2-x+b 比较 x 项系数：a=-1，再得 b=-2a=2。代入要求的不等式 bx^2-x+a≤0，得到 2x^2-x-1≤0，分解为 (2x+1)(x-1)≤0，所以解集为 [-1/2,1]。
method.CoT_raw: 从题面读出：关于 x 的不等式 ax²-x+b≥0 的解集是 [-2,1]。因此二次多项式 ax²-x+b 的两个零点是 -2 和 1，并且因为 ≥0 的解集在两根之间，所以抛物线开口向下。设 ax²-x+b=a(x+2)(x-1)。展开得 a(x²+x-2)=ax²+ax-2a。与 ax²-x+b 比较系数：x 项系数满足 a=-1；常数项满足 b=-2a=2。于是要求解的不等式 bx²-x+a≤0 变为 2x²-x-1≤0。分解得 2x²-x-1=(2x+1)(x-1)，所以 (2x+1)(x-1)≤0。两根为 x=-1/2 和 x=1，开口向上，因此小于等于 0 的解集在两根之间，即 [-1/2,1]。

method.method_draft: 从题面读出 p(t)=at^2-t+b 的非负解集为 [-2,1]。目标多项式 q(x)=bx^2-x+a 可写成 q(x)=x^2p(1/x)，因为 x^2p(1/x)=x^2(a/x^2-1/x+b)=a-x+bx^2。对 x≠0，由于 x^2>0，q(x)≤0 等价于 p(1/x)≤0。已知 p(t)≥0 只在 [-2,1] 上成立，因此 p(t)≤0 对应 t≤-2 或 t≥1。令 t=1/x，解 1/x≤-2 或 1/x≥1，得到 x∈[-1/2,0)∪(0,1]。再由已知 p 的非负解集是有限区间可知原二次函数开口向下，即 a<0，所以 q(0)=a<0，也应包含 x=0。合并得 [-1/2,1]。
